c1-23-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Avenue
c1-23-01.scenario: You are walking in Budapest and have read about the Andrássy út. Károly asks what the avenue connects.
c1-23-01.prompt: Tell Károly where the avenue runs and what it connects.
c1-23-01.target: Az Andrássy út hossztengelyében elnyúlva köti össze a belvárost a Városligettel.
c1-23-01.english: Stretching along its long axis, Andrássy Avenue connects the centre with the City Park.
c1-23-01.canDo: I can describe how streets and buildings lie with a -va/-ve participle (*hossztengelyében elnyúlva*, *sugarasan szétágazva*, *szintkülönbséget áthidalva*).

c1-23-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Fine Facade
c1-23-02.scenario: You are looking at an old apartment house in Budapest. Károly asks what the facade is like.
c1-23-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the facade is like.
cues: Use a participle before the noun
c1-23-02.target: A gazdagon díszített homlokzat szép látvány.
c1-23-02.english: The richly decorated facade is a fine sight.
c1-23-02.canDo: I can describe a facade with a participle before the noun (*gazdagon díszített*, *boltívesen kiképzett*, *Zsolnay-kerámiával borított*).

c1-23-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Keep or Pull Down
c1-23-03.scenario: You have read about a debate on an old house. Károly asks what the two sides want.
c1-23-03.prompt: Tell Károly what the two sides want.
c1-23-03.target: Míg a műemlékvédők a régi ház megőrzését kérik, addig a beruházók új épületet szeretnének.
c1-23-03.english: While the preservationists ask for the old house to be kept, the investors would like a new building.
c1-23-03.canDo: I can set two views against each other (*míg … addig*, *ezzel éles ellentétben*, *szembeállítva*).

c1-23-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Firm Judgement
c1-23-04.scenario: You have read about the Chain Bridge. Károly asks what you think of it.
c1-23-04.prompt: Tell Károly a firm judgement about the bridge.
c1-23-04.target: Vitán felül áll, hogy a Lánchíd a főváros ismert jelképe.
c1-23-04.english: It is beyond dispute that the Chain Bridge is a well-known symbol of the capital.
c1-23-04.canDo: I can state a firm judgement about a building (*vitán felül áll, hogy*, *joggal kifogásolható*, *méltán tartható számon*).

c1-23-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Buda and Pest
c1-23-05.scenario: You have read the text about Szerb Antal's guide. Károly asks how the guide shows Buda and Pest.
c1-23-05.prompt: Tell Károly how the houses stand in Pest and in Buda.
cues: Say how they stand in Pest
Say how they stand in Buda
c1-23-05.target: A pesti belvárosban sűrűn állnak a házak, a budai villanegyedben szellősen.
c1-23-05.english: In downtown Pest the houses stand densely, in the Buda villa district airily.
c1-23-05.canDo: I can say how closely buildings and people stand (*sűrűn*, *zsúfoltan*, *fojtogatóan*, *szellősen*).

c1-23-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the City
c1-23-consolidation.scenario: You have read about the city. Károly asks you to sum it up.
c1-23-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly one firm judgement and one contrast about the city.
c1-23-consolidation.target: Vitán felül áll, hogy a Lánchíd ismert jelkép, míg az új üvegtornyok vitát indítottak.
c1-23-consolidation.english: It is beyond dispute that the Chain Bridge is a well-known symbol, while the new glass towers started a debate.
c1-23-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for city plans, facades and the preservation debate.
